mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies near Verona City Hall and it is currently a New Moon phase.

The city has announced that road construction on Highway M will begin August 18, shifting traffic patterns for several weeks. Additionally, residents are reminded of upcoming election notices and development project reviews by the Plan Commission.
There is plenty to do in Verona today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga classes, the downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly report, on August 6, officers arrested a 49-year-old man for his fourth offence O W I after he was observed driving erratically.
Today's flavor is the classic Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM today for you to enjoy your treat.
